task: Build the branch-local Autonomy Signal generator that derives a machine-readable progress report and a deduplicated next-issue proposal from durable LCR state. Produce JSON and Markdown outputs and tests. This step must not publish externally, modify main/default branch, configure credentials, deploy, or touch Identity Kernel/personality/governance.
acceptance: Create missions/LIDIYA-CLOUD-RELAY-V2/autonomy_signal.py using only Python standard library
Signal output includes mission/status/step/current_role, rollback anchor, evidence pointers, cloud activation state, and a concise progress summary
Signal output derives a stable dedupe_key and next_issue from state; activation-gate states produce a requires_human issue without inventing completion
Pending-handoff state produces an actionable non-human handoff issue; IDLE with mission_result PASS produces no next issue
Create test_autonomy_signal.py with at least four deterministic tests covering HUMAN_GATE/deferred activation, pending handoff, IDLE PASS, and stable dedupe behavior
Generate signals/AUTONOMY-0002-LATEST.json and signals/AUTONOMY-0002-LATEST.md from the real current state snapshot
Builder runs py_compile and unittest for both relay state and autonomy signal tests, records exact counts, and returns BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED to LCR-C
No main/default-branch write, deployment, Identity Kernel/personality/governance change, credential/secret use, or destructive action
lesson: Autonomy should surface its own state-derived next issue and progress before adding a generative cloud model; deterministic signals provide a verifiable baseline.
